CoderActionHandleStatus.description: Status of an action handle. 'untouched' is legacy (treat like pending, read-only); writable via the feedback PUT are only approved / rejected / pending — 'deactivated' is bot-only.

CoderActionHandleKind.description: The four handle kinds: add = 'Ziffer übernehmen?' (proposed new billing item, payload in createdItem), remove = 'Bestandsposition streichen?' (targetEntryRef), adjust = 'Feld/Faktor ändern?' (enrichedFields), review = 'Bitte prüfen' (no payload). Rows with legacy kinds are hidden from all read paths.

CoderActionHandleSeverity.description: Urgency of the finding behind the handle (FindingSeverity).

CoderCandidateOutcome.description: Final outcome of a candidate in one run. bill_drafted = newly added to the invoice DRAFT; re_confirmed = existing item held its ground; existing_kept = as-is existing line mirrored unchanged; superseded = existing item stepped back; excluded_by_selection = filtered before evaluation; non_compliant = failed a compliance gate; implausible = failed plausibleIf; blocked_by_gop = excluded by another GOP (see blockedBy); not_in_optimal_invoice = passed all gates but lost against order/caps; suppressed_by_reviewer = expert-review veto (reason in reviewSuppressionReason); suppressed_by_condensate = dropped by the LLM relevance filter; mutually_excluded = lost a reviewer-declared same-event exclusion; no_occasion = expert seed without documented occasion; not_dated = date-less candidate, never simulated. Legacy stored value 'billed' is normalized to bill_drafted.

CoderCandidateOutcomeBucket.description: UI bucket derived from the outcome: bill_drafted → adopted; re_confirmed/existing_kept → confirmed; suppressed_by_reviewer/suppressed_by_condensate → suppressed; everything else → not_adopted.

CoderDocumentationAssessment.description: Reviewer's documentation assessment (stamped even when SUPPORTED).

checksum.description: MD5 checksum of the day's documentation

dayChecksums.description: Map of date strings to checksum objects

CoderActionHandleUserEdit.description: User-supplied feedback on an action handle. The UI typically surfaces clickable preset texts that PREFILL `comment`; the user can then edit/extend the text before submit. There is no structured reason enum — `comment` carries the full feedback as free text, valid for any status (not just rejected). The server overwrites userIdCreated with the authenticated user; clients should omit it.

userIdCreated.description: Set server-side from the access token; ignored if sent by clients

comment.description: Free-text feedback. Recommended on any status (approved/rejected/etc.) to build up gold-data examples.

flagIsBot.description: True for automated (bot) feedback — py-core bot edits carry it too.

CoderActionHandleSummary.description: Summary of an action handle (used in analysis list overview)

patientNumberPVS.description: Non-hashed practice-system patient number; only populated by methods that JOIN coder.patients (worklist/day lists — the patient-level action-handles endpoint does NOT)

birthDate.description: Same source as patientNumberPVS — present only when coder.patients is joined

category.description: FindingType literal (e.g. DOCUMENTATION_SUPPORT_ISSUE, BILLABLE_OMISSION); legacy rows may carry a free label (e.g. 'Allgemein')

categoryLabel.description: German display label for `category` (e.g. 'Dokumentationslücke', 'Fehlende Ziffer'); unknown categories pass through raw

gop.description: Normalized GOP/EBM code the handle refers to; null for case-level ('nogop') handles

monetaryValue.description: EUR value associated with the finding (e.g. GOP value for an add)

sourceRuleId.description: OPAQUE per-patient twin-matching key — stable across runs for the same semantic finding. Do NOT parse or derive display data from it (new-path rows use a /Sem/… grammar, legacy rows may carry plain rule ids).

evaluationId.description: The run that CREATED the handle — may be older than analysisObject.lastEvaluationId

dateUpdated.description: Raw last-edit timestamp; null if the row was never edited after creation

lastTouch.description: COALESCE(dateUpdated, dateCreated) — null-safe last-modification timestamp, used by ?updatedFrom/?updatedTo filters, sortBy=lastTouch and as the list nextCursor

description.description: Human-readable finding description (carries the reviewer sentences verbatim)

targetIds.description: UUIDs of the patient-file items the finding refers to. For an 'add' this typically contains the createdItem.id; for remove/adjust/review it points at existing items.

userEdit.description: Latest feedback snapshot; null while the handle is pending/untouched

meta.description: Reduced metadata — only the sanctioned keys below are exposed (undefined keys are omitted).

findingId.description: Id of the finding the handle was materialized from (fnd_…)

origin.description: Producer: rule id, reviewer finding id (e.g. 'F4'), 'draft_composer', or a check label

candidateRefs.description: Join path to the candidate-evaluation ledger — subject candidate first, then related. Resolve via GET …/evaluations/{evaluationId}/candidates/{candidateId}.

gopUnvalidated.description: True when a catalog check failed for an LLM-named GOP

createdItem.description: add-kind only: the proposed billing item (GOPEntry, PVS-style keys — GOP, GOPText, GOPLANR, GOType, GOPBstNumber, monetaryValue, GOPFactor, GOPComment, flagInvoiced, documentationDate, doctorShortHand, locationShortHand, caseId, hzvContractId, …). Absent for other kinds.

state.description: Per-rule state flags, e.g. { flagIdentified: true, candidateId: 'cand_…' }

targetEntryRef.description: remove-kind only: reference to the existing billing entry the handle proposes to strike. Absent for other kinds.

enrichedFields.description: adjust-kind only: the proposed field changes. Absent for other kinds.

traces.description: Condition evaluation trace tree — single-GET with flagIncludeTraces=true only; otherwise stripped by the `data - 'traces'` SQL projection

analysisObject.description: Embedded parent analysis object payload (populated via LEFT JOIN on analysis_object_ident). Always present on the response; null when the action handle has no analysis object attached. Read the FK target via analysisObject.ident.

inboundTotalMonetaryValue.description: Value of the invoice the practice actually entered (per GOType, excluding identified items)

lastEvaluationId.description: Entry point for the candidate-evaluation ledger of the youngest completed run

inboundTotalMonetaryValue.description: Value of the invoice the practice actually entered (per GOType, excluding identified items)

lastEvaluationId.description: Id of the youngest completed run — entry point for the candidate-evaluation ledger ('latest')

CoderCandidateEvaluationItem.description: One row of the candidate-evaluation ledger (list shape): the outcome of one candidate (GOP × target date) in one run, with API-side German decoration. Columns only — the structured depth lives on the detail endpoint.

candidateId.description: RUN-LOCAL candidate id (cand_…) — only meaningful together with evaluationId

evaluationId.description: The run this evaluation belongs to

gop.description: Normalized GOP/EBM code (subject of the evaluation)

targetDate.description: Target service day; null for not_dated candidates

label.description: Short catalog text of the service

intent.description: Evaluation intent; null = validation of an already-billed GOP

outcomeLabel.description: German short label for the outcome (e.g. 'Übernommen', 'Bestand bestätigt')

blockedBy.description: The blocking GOP when outcome = blocked_by_gop

standaloneCompliant.description: Standalone compliance at targetDate; null = never checked

reviewStatus.description: null = review not applicable / not run

documentationAssessmentLabel.description: German sentence fragment for the assessment (e.g. 'nur teilweise durch die Dokumentation gedeckt')

reviewSuppressed.description: Suppressed by the reviewer (reason in reviewSuppressionReason on the detail)

originType.description: Concrete producer; null for probabilistic/actual_gops origins

explanation.description: Pre-rendered German candidate explanation (≤ 1200 chars) — directly displayable

allOf.description: Detail shape: all list fields plus the structured depth from the ledger's JSONB payload. Pipeline internals (signals, signalRef, plausibility, tokenUsage, emittedHandles, provenance, provenanceDetail) are stripped.

decision.description: The complete CandidateDecision — findings, verbatim reviewer notes and the structured gate stack.

reviewNotes.description: VERBATIM reviewer sentences — identical to what handle descriptions embed (deliberately redundant, do not deduplicate)

findings.description: ALL findings on this candidate (subject or related), incl. ledger-only ones. Enriched with a German typeLabel.

payload.description: Typed per finding type: GOPEntry (BILLABLE_OMISSION), factor assessment, or enriched-field list

explanation.description: Structured gate stack (DecisionExplanation) — source of the explainability panel (gateLabel → section heading, verdicts[].requirement/observed → Soll/Ist).

compliance.description: Per-date isolated compliance: { '<ISO date>': { compliant, monetaryValue, summary, blockedBy[], blockedByGopRefs[], matchedRulesCount } }

reviewSuppressionReason.description: Verbatim reviewer reason when reviewSuppressed = true — the only user-visible 'why' for a suppressed proposal

currentlyBilledDates.description: Days the GOP is already billed on

pendingCount.description: Total pending action handles for this patient

CoderAnalysisListResponse.description: Response for /list/analysis - patients with analysis results

totalCount.description: Total count (may be null for performance)

analysisObjects.description: Analysis objects for this patient (only included if flagIncludeAnalysisObjects=true)

CoderPatientFileListResponse.description: Response for /list/patients - patient files sorted by modification date

CoderTriggerAnalysisResponse.description: Response for triggering a patient analysis

CoderGeneralSettings.description: Effective general coder settings — defaults applied server-side for missing fields.

patientFileHistoryBackInDays.description: History depth — how far back chart data is pulled per patient. `null` means no cap (unbegrenzt). Governs how much chart data leaves the practice per patient.

autoDeleteEnabled.description: When true, patient files untouched for `autoDeleteDays` days are removed by the cleanup job.

patientFileQueryModifiedSinceInDays.description: Change-detection window — patients with documentation modified within the last N days are pulled. Tune to the practice's sync cadence (daily → 3, weekly → ≥7, monthly → 30).

get.summary: Get Coder activation state for the org
get.description:
Returns the per-org activation record for the Coder app:
status (`enabled` / `disabled` / `paused`), the reason if paused,
activation/deactivation timestamps, and a tail of the status-change
history. Settings (history depth, retention etc.) live separately
under `optimizersettings.coder` and are NOT included here.

200.description: Activation record (never null — defaults to `disabled` if never activated).

post.summary: Activate the Coder app for the org
post.description:
Initial activation, called by the onboarding dialog after the user
has accepted the terms. Idempotent — a second call when already
enabled returns the existing state without side effects.

delete.summary: Deactivate the Coder app for the org
delete.description:
Sets status to `disabled`. Tunable settings (history depth,
retention) are NOT touched, so a later re-activation restores them.

put.description:
User-initiated status change. The accepted values are intentionally
restricted to `enabled` and `disabled`; `paused` is a system-owned
state and cannot be set through this endpoint. Use the dedicated
resume path (currently `PUT` with `status: enabled` after a top-up)
to leave a paused state.

A `412 Precondition Failed` is returned when the user tries to
enable while credits are insufficient — the UI should surface the
top-up flow on this response.

200.description: Status updated; returns the new activation record.

400.description: Invalid body (e.g. status not in [enabled, disabled]).

post.summary: Decommission ("Stilllegen") the Coder app for the org
post.description:
Offboarding action. Flips status to `disabled`, tags the activation
record with decommission metadata (`decommissionedAt`,
`decommissionedBy`, `purgeRequested`), and — when `purgeData: true`
— requests an asynchronous purge of the org's coder data.

The purge worker is currently **stubbed** on the backend: the
activation record records the request (`purgeStatus: 'pending'`),
but no worker picks it up yet. Clients should not block on
completion. Treat the 200 response as "decommission request
recorded, purge scheduled" — not "purge done."

The org's purchase / entitlement is NOT cancelled by this
endpoint — that lives separately.

purgeData.description: When true, additionally request a data purge.

200.description: Decommission recorded; returns the updated activation record.

get.summary: Get the org's latest purge job
get.description:
Returns the latest purge job (decommission, auto-retention, or
manual) for the org — used by the Gefahrenzone in the frontend
to render progress while a decommission is running and to lock
the "Coder stilllegen" button.

Response shape mirrors the `coder_purge_jobs` document: state,
counters, kind, timestamps. Returns null when the org has never
had a purge job.

200.description: Latest purge job document, or null if none.

post.summary: Create a new practice instance (unattended onboarding)
post.description: Creates a new practice instance (organization) via unattended onboarding. This endpoint is designed for automated instance creation by business partners using API keys with the 'unattended-onboarding' scope. The endpoint will create a new organization, set up the organization owner user, and optionally create an admin user. Infrastructure setup and account validation emails are sent automatically. This endpoint requires (a) dedicated contractual agreement with systolics and  (b) a dedicated API key with the 'unattended-onboarding' scope. Further configuration (e.g. customization of registration flows) are  possible, but require specific configuration. Please contact your account manager for more information.

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: The ID of the business partner organization that is creating the new instance. This is derived from the API key used for authentication.

parameters.name: flowType
parameters.description: Optional flow type for registration. Determines whether the user is registered as organization owner or admin. Only applicable if the business partner allows registration flow choices. Defaults to the business partner's default flow type.

parameters.name: autoGeneratePassword
parameters.description: Optional flag to auto-generate a strong password. Only applicable if the business partner allows registration flow choices. Defaults to true otherwise.

email.description: Email address of the organization owner user

name.description: First name of the organization owner user

surname.description: Last name of the organization owner user

password.description: Password for the organization owner user; required if registration flow type is 'orgowner'. Must comply with strong requirements as per "^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*[0-9])(?=.*[+-;:~.!@#\$%\^&\*])(?=.{8,})"

LANR.description: Optional LANR (Lebenslange Arztnummer) for medical professionals, leave empty if not applicable.

bstNumber.description: BST number (Betriebsstättennummer). It is required for Germany (DE), place a 0 for private only clinics.

kvCode.description: KV code (Kassenärztliche Vereinigung). Please refer to the KV-Schlüsseltabellen for the correct KV code for your organization.

rebates.description: Optional rebate configuration for the organization. Contains rebate selection data.

legalNoticePartner.description: Flag indicating if the legal notice for the partner rebate has been accepted

rebates.description: Array of rebate IDs and codes to apply to the organization. The provided rebates are automatically selected and validated against available rebates of the partner account. Invalid items will be discarded.

200.description: Successfully created a new practice instance. Returns the created organization, organization owner user, and optional admin user information along with pipeline execution status.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the organization owner user

email.description: Email address of the organization owner user

userId.description: Unique identifier of the admin user (if created)

400.description: Bad request - Invalid input or missing required fields. This can occur if required fields are missing, email format is invalid, password is not strong enough, or organization information is incomplete.

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid API key. The API key is either missing, invalid, or has expired.

403.description: Forbidden - The business partner organization is not activated for unattended onboarding, or the API key does not have the required 'unattended-onboarding' scope.

406.description: Not acceptable - Invalid user or organization data. This can occur if the email is invalid, password is not strong enough, or organization data does not meet requirements.

500.description: Internal server error - An unexpected error occurred during the onboarding process.

get.summary: Get Candidate Evaluations for a Run
get.description:
Returns the candidate-evaluation ledger of one analysis run — one row
per considered candidate (GOP × target date), including candidates
that did NOT make it into the invoice draft or merely re-confirm the
existing invoice. This is the compact "Prüfprotokoll" feed: columns
only, no structured depth (see the detail endpoint for that).

`evaluationId` may be the literal `latest`, which resolves via
`analysis_objects.last_evaluation_id` (the youngest completed run).

Each row carries the raw `outcome` plus API-side German decoration:
`outcomeLabel` (short display label), `outcomeBucket`
(adopted | confirmed | suppressed | not_adopted, for the summary
chips) and `documentationAssessmentLabel`. `explanation` is
pre-rendered German and directly displayable.

Resume runs can append a second row per candidate — duplicates are
collapsed server-side (highest row ident wins).

parameters.name: evaluationId
parameters.description: Run/evaluation id, or the literal `latest` for the youngest completed run

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Filter by outcome (single value, comma-separated, or repeated query param)

parameters.name: documentationAssessment
parameters.description: Filter by documentation assessment (single value, comma-separated, or repeated query param)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of candidates to return

evaluationId.description: The resolved evaluation id (useful when `latest` was requested)

404.description: Analysis object not found for this patient, or no completed evaluation yet

get.description:
Returns the full evaluation of one candidate in one run: all list
fields plus the structured depth from the ledger's JSONB payload —
the complete `decision` (findings enriched with a German `typeLabel`,
verbatim reviewer notes, the structured gate-stack `explanation`),
origin evidence, per-date compliance, factor review, the
review-suppression reason, currently billed dates and the committed
entry pricing (`entryAmount` / `entryFactor` / `entryComment`).

Pipeline internals (signals, LLM metadata, provenance) are stripped.

`candidateId` is RUN-LOCAL (`cand_…`) — it is only meaningful in
combination with the `evaluationId` (action handles reference it via
`meta.candidateRefs[] = {candidateId, evaluationId}`). `evaluationId`
may be the literal `latest`.

parameters.name: evaluationId
parameters.description: Run/evaluation id, or the literal `latest` for the youngest completed run

get.description:
Returns action handles for the patient across all analysis objects,
filterable by status, kind, date range, and list affiliation.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by action handle status (single value or repeated query param)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filter by action handle kind (single value, comma-separated, or repeated query param)

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Filter by action handle severity (single value, comma-separated, or repeated query param)

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Include handles with `date` >= dateFrom (medical/event date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd)

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Include handles with `date` <= dateTo (medical/event date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd)

parameters.name: updatedFrom
parameters.description:
Include handles whose last-touch >= updatedFrom. Last-touch is
COALESCE(date_updated, date_created), null-safe for rows never
edited after creation. Composes with dateFrom/dateTo, e.g.
"current quarter (date filter) AND touched in last 5 days".

parameters.name: updatedTo
parameters.description: Include handles whose last-touch <= updatedTo (COALESCE(date_updated, date_created))

parameters.name: listIdent
parameters.description: Limit to handles affiliated with the given list (via coder.rel_list_entry_action_handle)

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description:
Sort field (default dateUpdated). `lastTouch` sorts by
COALESCE(date_updated, date_created) so never-touched rows
still rank by creation time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of action handles to return

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of action handles to skip

400.description:
Invalid query parameter. Returned when:
- `status` contains a value not in [pending, approved, rejected, deactivated, untouched]
- `sortBy` is not one of [dateCreated, dateUpdated, lastTouch]
- `listIdent` is not parseable as an integer
- `dateQuery.field` (internal) is not one of [date, dateCreated, dateUpdated, lastTouch]

error.description: Human-readable message naming the bad parameter and (when applicable) the allowed values

get.description:
Returns a single action handle by ID.
Contains the full action handle data including payload and user edits.

put.description:
Updates an action handle with user feedback.
Used to approve, reject, or add comments to findings.

status.description: New status for the action handle (writable subset)

put.description:
Updates an action handle with user feedback (status change + optional comment).
This is the canonical URL: works for both AO-attached handles and list-only
handles (those without an `analysis_object_ident`). Prefer this over the
legacy AO-nested URL.

Every successful PUT writes atomically to two places:
- `coder.action_handles` — overwrites the latest userEdit snapshot
- `coder.action_handle_feedback` — appends a permanent history row

The UI should surface preset texts that prefill the `comment` field;
the user can edit/extend before submit. There is no structured reason
enum — `comment` is free text and is valid on any status (not just rejection).

newStatus.description:
Target status. `status` is also accepted as an alias. Only
approved / rejected / pending are writable — 'deactivated'
is bot-only, 'untouched' is legacy read-only; anything else
returns 400.

oldStatus.description: Optimistic-UI hint; validated but not enforced as compare-and-swap.

comment.description:
Optional free-text feedback. Typically prefilled from a UI preset and
then edited by the user. Recommended on every status (not just
rejection) for gold-data accumulation.

flagIsBot.description: Marks automated (bot) feedback; persisted into data.userEdit.

200.description: Status updated and history row recorded

data.description: Partial response — refetch the full handle if needed.

400.description: Invalid body (bad status enum, non-integer actionHandleId, etc.)

get.description:
Returns the raw per-step `done` flags for the Coder onboarding
stepper. The frontend layers `open` / `blocked` / `no-permission`
on top — this endpoint stays focused on data truth.

Admin-only because some signals (patient_file counts, active
purchases) are sensitive. Members get a 403 and the frontend
renders a read-only "Fehlende Berechtigungen" layout without
step detail.

Returns a list of all configured tasks (rule items) for the organization.
Tasks define individual billing-code checks that are evaluated by the rule engine.

post.description:
Creates a new task (rule item) for the organization.
The simplified input is transformed into the full rule-engine document format on the server.
Requires settings write permission.

get.description: Returns a single task by ID with its full configuration.

put.description:
Updates user-editable fields of an existing task.
Backend-managed fields (reasoning, policy) are never overwritten.
Requires settings write permission.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes a task. The document is retained in the database with flagDeleted set.
Requires settings write permission.
